Does Chipotle have vegan options?
faq.answer: Yes, Chipotle offers several vegan-friendly ingredients, including Sofritas, beans, rice, fajita vegetables, and guacamole.

faq.question: Can I order Chipotle online?
faq.answer: Yes, you can place orders through the Chipotle website or mobile app for pickup or delivery.

faq.question: Does Chipotle offer delivery?
faq.answer: Yes, delivery is available at many locations through the Chipotle app and third-party delivery services.

faq.question: Does Chipotle have a kids menu?
faq.answer: Yes, Chipotle offers Kids Build Your Own meals and Kids Quesadilla options.

faq.question: Are Chipotle menu prices the same at every location?
faq.answer: No, prices may vary depending on the restaurant location.

faq.question: Does Chipotle serve gluten-free food?
faq.answer: Many menu items are naturally gluten-free, but cross-contact may occur during preparation.

faq.question: Can I customize my Chipotle order?
faq.answer: Yes, you can customize your burrito, bowl, tacos, salad, and other menu items with your preferred ingredients.

faq.question: Does Chipotle provide nutritional information?
faq.answer: Yes, nutrition facts and calorie information are available for all menu items.
